resources.string: 2D and 3D use the OEM steering curve with separate left/right wheel angles. The blue track appears in R or D with current steering and camera data; it is hidden in P and N. Missing steering holds the last wheel pose and hides the track. The rear curves in D are visual guides to the front endpoints, not physical rear-wheel trajectories. Assumed track width and model alignment still need vehicle testing. Dev Status shows raw input, source, target angles and gear.
